_readme: Source of truth for the shooting script. Edit a line here, then run: node scripts/apply-script.mjs — it updates data/responses.json and regenerates SHOOTING-SCRIPT.md.

idle.do: Sit still. Breathe. Blink. Small shift of weight halfway through. Look at the lens like you're waiting for someone to speak. 15 seconds, no talking.

greeting_a.do: Look up like you've just noticed them. Small genuine smile.
greeting_a.line: Hey! You came. That's more than I expected.

greeting_b.do: Open both arms slightly, mock-presenting the room.
greeting_b.line: Welcome to my very professional farewell website.

greeting_c.line: Oh. Hi. I was just standing here looping.

goodbye_a.do: Small wave, then let the hand drop like you regret starting it.
goodbye_a.line: Bye! Or as I'm now contractually required to say — let's keep in touch.

goodbye_b.do: Nod once. Hold eye contact a beat longer than comfortable.

compliment_a.do: Wave it away, then immediately gesture for more.
compliment_a.line: Stop it. Keep going. Stop it.

compliment_b.do: Point at the camera like you're taking a note.
compliment_b.line: I'm putting that in writing and forwarding it to HR on my way out.

compliment_c.do: Drop the bit. Say it straight.

roast_a.line: Wow. On my last week. Bold.

roast_b.do: Tap your badge or your chest. Slight menace, all friendly.
roast_b.line: You know I've still got building access until Friday, right?

roast_c.do: Shrug, mouth turned down. Fully conceding.

why_a.line: New chapter, same me, slightly better chair.

why_b.do: Start sincere, then let it curdle.
why_b.line: It was time. Also nobody ever fixed that printer.

where_a.do: Look off to the middle distance, mock-wistful.
where_a.line: Somewhere new. Somewhere exciting. Somewhere with a working coffee machine.

where_b.line: Buy me a drink and I'll tell you everything.

touch_a.do: Count them off on your fingers.
touch_a.line: Absolutely. LinkedIn, WhatsApp, carrier pigeon. I'm reachable.

touch_b.line: Please do. I'll be the one replying six days later.

miss_a.do: Hand up, look away. Genuinely a bit caught out.
miss_a.line: Don't. I'm barely holding it together as it is.

miss_b.do: Straight to camera. No joke in it.

luck_a.line: Thank you. I'll need roughly all of it.

luck_b.line: That means more than you know.

thanks_a.do: Shake your head, point back at them.

thanks_b.line: That means a lot. Now stop, people are looking.

joke_a.do: Point at camera. Mouth the words with them.
joke_a.line: Not my problem after Friday. Say it with me.

joke_b.do: Mime closing a laptop. Enormous contentment.
joke_b.line: I've marked it Won't Fix and I've never been happier.

joke_c.line: I'm declining that invite from beyond the grave.

advice_a.line: Take the lunch break. Every single day. That's it. That's the wisdom.

advice_b.do: Lean in slightly, like real advice.
advice_b.line: Ask the stupid question early. It's much cheaper than asking it late.

memory_a.do: Puff cheeks, look up, genuinely thinking.
memory_a.line: Too many to pick. Most of them happened in a kitchen, not a meeting room.

memory_b.line: You know the one. We agreed never to speak of it.

food_a.line: The fridge is yours now. I'm so sorry.

food_b.do: Hold up an imaginary mug. Non-negotiable.
food_b.line: I'm taking the good mug. This isn't a discussion.

back_a.line: Never say never. Especially if you're buying lunch.

back_b.line: I'll visit. I'll even sign in at reception like a stranger.

willmiss_a.do: Warm, then a hard turn on the last bit.
willmiss_a.line: The people. Obviously the people. Absolutely not the parking.

willmiss_b.do: Point vaguely around the room. Knowing look.
willmiss_b.line: All of you. Some of you slightly more. You know who you are.

party_a.do: Three fingers, counting down, getting less confident.
party_a.line: First round's on me. Second round's on you. Third round is a mystery.

party_b.line: I'll be there. I'll be emotional. Bring tissues.

affection_a.do: Hand on heart, then a glance off-camera.
affection_a.line: Love you too. In an entirely HR-compliant way.

affection_b.line: That's very sweet and I'm choosing to believe you mean it.

nonsense_a.line: I have no idea what that meant and I respect it enormously.

fallback_a.do: Blank. Then a small delighted smile.
fallback_a.line: I have no idea how to respond to that, and I love that for us.

fallback_b.do: Lean in interested, then immediately give up.
fallback_b.line: Interesting. Say more. Actually, don't — I'm leaving.

fallback_c.line: That one's going in the memoir.
